question: Should OpenClaw adopt this versioned, core-owned experimental Claw update-plan and capability-consent contract as the basis for the dependent apply-stage implementation?
rationale: The choice establishes a new CLI and machine-readable lifecycle contract spanning persisted ownership, sensitive capability disclosure, and the follow-up mutation executor; patch correctness alone cannot determine whether that permanent core boundary is desired.

options.title: Accept the experimental stacked contract
options.body: Review and land the prerequisite lifecycle slice first, then merge this planner after exact-head proof confirms the final disclosure behavior.

options.title: Narrow or defer the core contract
options.body: Pause this stack and move any acceptable subset behind a smaller maintainer-approved lifecycle or plugin API boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept the experimental stacked contract
recommendation.body: Review and land the prerequisite lifecycle slice first, then merge this planner after exact-head proof confirms the final disclosure behavior.
